hooks.command: b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [[ -z "$b" || "$b" =~ ^(feature/t-[0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*|(fix|chore|docs)/[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*)$ ]]; then exit 0; fi; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Branch %s does not match CONTRIBUTORS.md convention. Expected: feature/t-<id>-<slug>, fix/<slug>, chore/<slug>, or docs/<slug>. Rename with: git branch -m <new-name>"}}\n' "$b"

b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); t=$(echo "$b" | sed -nE 's|^feature/(t-[0-9]+).*|\1|p' | tr a-z A-Z); if [[ -n "$t" ]]; then m="PR opened. Flip $t in docs/PROJECT_TRACKER.xlsx to In Progress."; else m="PR opened. Update the matching task row in docs/PROJECT_TRACKER.xlsx to In Progress."; fi; printf '{"systemMessage":"%s"}\n' "$m"
